from pathlib import Path
import subprocess, json, os, hashlib, time, datetime, shutil, sys

root = Path('/workspace/avatarrpg-env/review-379')
source = Path('/workspace/avatarrpg-379')
project = sys.argv[1]
assert project in {'desktop-canvas', 'ipad-canvas', 'desktop-webgl', 'ipad-webgl'}
label = sys.argv[2]
assert label and all(c.isalnum() or c in '-_' for c in label)
run_dir = root / 'runs' / label
run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
def fingerprint():
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['node', str(root/'provenance.mjs'), str(source)], text=True))
def runner_hash():
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

before = fingerprint()
assert not before['dirty'], 'Refusing capture with source changes'
build = json.loads((root/'build-receipt.json').read_text())
assert build['stable'] and build['exitCode'] == 0, 'Build must pass before capture'
for key in ('revision', 'headTree', 'sourceSha256', 'helpersSha256', 'harnessSha256', 'buildSha256'):
    assert before[key] == build[key], f'Build receipt differs at {key}'
environment = os.environ.copy()
environment.update(FNT_REVIEW379_LABEL=label, PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='/workspace/avatarrpg-env/review-368-motion/pw-tools')
command = [str(source/'node_modules/.bin/playwright'), 'test', '-c', str(root/'playwright.config.ts'), '--project', project]
result = {'before':before, 'build_receipt':build, 'project':project, 'label':label, 'command':command,
          'artifact_dir':str(root/'artifacts'/label), 'runner_sha256_before':runner_hash(),
          'started_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
started = time.monotonic()
with (run_dir/'browser.log').open('w') as output:
    process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=source, env=environment, stdout=output, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
result.update(exit_code=process.returncode, duration_seconds=time.monotonic()-started,
              after=fingerprint(), runner_sha256_after=runner_hash(),
              finished_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
result['stable'] = result['before'] == result['after'] and result['runner_sha256_before'] == result['runner_sha256_after']
if (root/'results.json').is_file():
    shutil.copy2(root/'results.json',run_dir/'playwright-report.json')
(run_dir/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(process.returncode if result['stable'] else 99)

# Forest Road #379 native review protocol

Prepared only; no builds/browser/test/encoder run until root assigns the slot.

1. Root reviews `e2e/forest-road-polish.review.ts` and this harness, then allocates the serial slot.
2. Parent commits the fixture before building so the displayed revision names clean committed source. From `/workspace/avatarrpg-379`, run `node /workspace/avatarrpg-env/review-379/prepare-build.mjs`.
3. Run `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/workspace/avatarrpg-env/review-368-motion/pw-tools node_modules/.bin/playwright test -c /workspace/avatarrpg-env/review-379/playwright.config.ts --project desktop-canvas` as the pilot. Set that environment variable before launching Playwright because its browser registry can initialize before the config module body. Run each remaining project serially after the pilot is understood. Preserve failures and label reruns explicitly; retries are zero.
4. Inspect `artifacts/<unique-label>/<test-project>/audit/beats.json` and its PNGs. The JSON holds full real state, camera, renderer, source/build digests, wall and performance timestamps, commands/results, and failure stage. Video is the native Playwright continuous recording beside the audit folder. Match beats to video using the test start; the few milliseconds of context creation before test start need an explicitly measured offset for exact frame annotation.
5. Curate one continuous native segment (forest-road through ambush-opening is the intended short interval), using actual frame timestamps and recording the start/end offset. Trim and encode only after the capture slot completes; do not speed up, splice or retime. Keep the full local WebM as provenance and the shared clip under 8,000,000 bytes. Stills fail if they exceed that bound. No encoder has run during preparation.

Four cases: desktop 1280×800 DPR1 mouse, portrait 834×1194 DPR2 touch; Canvas and forced WebGL for each. The external config launches the installed `/usr/bin/chromium` with no added launch arguments. It sets `PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/workspace/avatarrpg-env/review-368-motion/pw-tools` to reuse the existing task-local ffmpeg. No installation or downloads are performed. These are viewport/backend reviews, not Safari, physical iPad, GPU performance, audio listening or accessibility acceptance. Raw videos are kept. Failed cases retain DOM/action/source traces with screenshot sampling disabled.

Beats: Ba Dan arrival and east gate; Forest Road arrival from the real gate, west walk, road narration, pre-ambush road; ambush opening; start/acted state of the first three party turns; actual victory; aftermath; walk east; quarry gate approach and real arrival. No forced flask beat: the existing Forest Road authors an Oil Flask at (13,6), but this planner route does not force the old fixture's flask attack. If ordinary play does not exercise its preview/burning surface, that remains an explicit coverage gap mapped to #328/#342; no claim that the prop is absent or that its lesson passed is made.

Setup skips title/setup via seeded `newGame` only. The rest of the route uses normal UI taps/controls. Combat adapts the existing `quarry-return.spec.ts` planner driver without its HP flattening: `previewAiPlan`, real `reachable` and `contactEffects`, normal `App.dispatch`, native animator waits. The AI profile is supplied only on a throwaway recommendation draft. No live HP/position/terrain mutation, explicit victory, clock pause/fast-forward, runtime freeze, rule copy, new generation or DeepSeek.

Budgets: one worker, retries 0, 30-minute per-review-case cap inherited from the old demo review; default shared helper bounds unchanged (settle 30s, idle 20s, turn/opening 25s), action 30s, expect 10s; combat capped at 160 party turns / 8 actions per turn like the existing campaign driver. Rough slot estimate is 3–8 minutes Canvas and 10–30 minutes software WebGL per case; these estimates are unmeasured. Legal planner play may lose, movement may stall, or software WebGL may exceed native helper bounds. Such outcomes remain failed evidence, not a reason to alter rules, HP, budgets or checks.

Known limits: fixture has not been run yet; it does not directly exercise combat aim/confirmation UI because recommendations are dispatched as normal commands, though all animation and enemy AI remain native. Source/build bytes, HEAD tree, shared helpers and external harness files are fingerprinted and checked before/after the route against the explicit build receipt. The title's displayed build must match the initial seven-character revision. The committed fixture derives the external harness directory from Playwright's config path and the source root from its own test path; it contains no machine-specific workspace path. Runtime state at a still is sampled just before PNG readback; readback can advance several native frames on software GL. The incoming/outgoing route positions and full first-turn state are retained; flock state has no public debug hook, and save/reload is outside this bounded capture.


## One corrected portrait WebGL capture

The original full-recording portraitWebGL run exited1 after1563.58s at the second party handoff: the Ready click completed, then the unchanged30s action deadline expired waiting for scheduled-navigation bookkeeping. Its accessibility snapshot showed Sura controls and no Ready card; page/console errors were empty. This was not the30-minute case deadline, and video is not proven to be its sole cause. Full original config/scripts/build receipt, video, trace, state and failed outcome are preserved under harness-history/full-recording and artifacts/run1-ipad-webgl.

The only resolved config change for one corrected attempt is ipad-webgl.use.video:on→off. Issue379 requests stills plus one short clip; desktopCanvas supplies the clip. All18portraitnativePNGbeats, real route/assertions, DPR2, unchanged30-minute case/30s action/shared-helper limits, zero automatic retries and canonical failure tracing remain. The other three project options are deep-equal to the originals. Source/game/fixture/helpers are unchanged. This corrected case does not establish portraitWebGL continuous-motion acceptance.

Require a new successful stable build receipt binding the changed harness, then use the unique label run2-ipad-webgl-stills. Preserve the original failure separately from the corrected outcome, even if that attempt passes. No further unchanged retry is planned.

            'combat-turn-3-start','fight-end','after-the-road','quarry-gate-approach','quarry-gate-arrival']
def digest(p): return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def probe(p): return json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['ffprobe','-v','error','-show_streams','-show_format','-of','json',str(p)],text=True))

runs = []
for project in projects:
    label = labels[project]

    assert receipt['stable'], label+' source/build changed'
